name: Task_4_DoubtHub
description: This is a group task in which we are building a college-specific doubt solving platform where students from different technical domains can post their doubts and other students can answer them.

paragraphs: An AI/ML-powered Question & Answer community platform tailored for college students to post, discover, and resolve technical doubts efficiently.
The backend and ML service run on Render's free tier and sleep when idle. The first request after a pause can take 30–60 seconds.
features: Domain classification (Model 1): predicts Backend, Cyber Security, DSA, Frontend, ML/AI or Programming Language from the question text.
Similar-question recommendation (Model 2): TF-IDF + KMeans clustering with cosine similarity, run within the predicted domain's dataset.
Signup and login with bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication, with domain selection.
Questions: create (domain auto-assigned by the ML model), list, inbox by domain, my questions, resolve.
